purpose: Describe failed close-envelope resolution and persistence on a T-only primary path without learning thresholds or asserting compact-disorder truth.

profile.reentry_rule: first later close through T that returns inside the escape event's frozen pre-escape envelope

event_schema.UPPER_ESCAPE: current close is strictly above the maximum of the previous ten closes
event_schema.LOWER_ESCAPE: current close is strictly below the minimum of the previous ten closes
event_schema.INSIDE: current close is inside or equal to the previous-ten-close envelope
event_schema.RESOLVED_ESCAPE: a later close by T re-enters the frozen pre-escape envelope
event_schema.UNRESOLVED_ESCAPE: no later close by T re-enters the frozen pre-escape envelope
